verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox lands his E-in, Q-out combo on cooldown before level 6 and snowballs the solo-kill advantage the data shows him holding; you win if you survive to a Rylai's-Riftmaker-Bramble spike where his sustain gets cut and his mobility stops mattering.

thesis: This matchup measures at 49.4% over 621 games with lane and solo-kill advantage both flagged to Aatrox, and the reason is tempo: his E (Umbral Dash) resets off Q casts and lets him dash into a trade, land the Q edge, and dash back out before Mordekaiser's slower melee kit can punish. Mordekaiser has no answer to that hit-and-run early, but he out-scales through item power (Rylai's slow removes Aatrox's dash advantage) and owns the only real counter to Aatrox's identity: his own ultimate removes Aatrox from any team-fueled sustain and makes it a stat-check 1v1.

theirWindow.when: passive glowing and E charge up
theirWindow.what: This is his all-in window — the empowered auto heals him and the dash lets him initiate and disengage safely. Do not extend the trade; back off and let him waste the proc on a minion or on nothing.

yourWindow.what: Aatrox has no sidestep or gap-close left, so this is when you walk up and land Q (Obliterate) or E (Death's Grasp) for full value — he can't dodge or reposition out of it.

start.why: This is the safer 20.1%-pick line (50.7% WR over 152 games) into a matchup with a measured lane disadvantage — the extra base regen and physical damage reduction blunt Aatrox's Q-E poke pattern better than Doran's Ring does against an AD opponent.

boots.why: 82.8% pick and the higher-sample choice (50.3% over 582 games) — the flat auto-attack damage reduction directly weakens both his Q third-hit and his Deathbringer Stance empowered auto.

core.why: The slow is the actual answer to Aatrox's E mobility — it's the first item in every meaningfully-winning build path (68.8% and 53.8% samples both start here).
Omnivamp lets you win extended trades once his burst window is gone, and it's the second item in the highest-winrate path (68.8% over 16 games).
Grievous Wounds shuts down both Deathbringer Stance healing and his R sustain — the Rylai's-Riftmaker-Thornmail path measures 68.8% over 16 games, the best sample of the three core paths listed.

situational.when: he is snowballing early and you need grievous wounds before your third item completes
he builds tanky and you need the burn to punish his healing over time instead of a full Thornmail spike
you need a cheap early grievous wounds component before Bramble or Thornmail finishes

runes.keystoneWhy: The 49%-pick page runs Conqueror and it's the higher-sample choice; stacking it in extended trades matters more here than a burst keystone since your win condition is outlasting him, not out-trading him early.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 87% of games at this matchup's largest sample (49.1% WR) — Ignite's grievous wounds stacks with your Bramble/Thornmail plan to shut down his sustain during the level 3-5 all-in window where he otherwise wins the damage race.

playing.title: Poke with W, not Q, pre-6
playing.detail: Siphon of Destruction has the range to punish his farming without walking into Q-E dash range. Save Q (Obliterate) trades for when his E charges are down.

playing.title: Never extend past his empowered auto
playing.detail: Once Deathbringer Stance is glowing, disengage rather than trade through it — that single auto is where most of his early kill pressure comes from.

playing.title: Shield with E before contact
playing.detail: Death's Grasp gives you a damage shield on cast — throw it as he closes distance, not after he's already landed his combo.

playing.title: Stack passive before committing
playing.detail: Let Darkness Rise build a stack or two on minions/Aatrox before going for a real trade so your next auto is empowered when it counts.

playing.title: Hold R for his all-in, not for a kill
playing.detail: Realm of Death removes him from any nearby allied healing or peel — it's most valuable as a defensive answer to his World Ender, not as a kill tool.

playing.title: Play for level 9-13, not level 3
playing.detail: The measured solo-kill advantage sits in the early levels; if you play passively through it, Rylai's and Riftmaker flip the duel in your favor without you needing to win a single early trade.

patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning — why the numbers land this way, which cooldowns and windows to play around — is my own analysis layered on top.
